script.title: INTERNET INSTALL DAY
script.story_hook: A tech comes to install wifi and fix dead zones.
script.intro_zh: 技師上門安裝網路、順便補強訊號死角。
script.welcome_en: Hello friends, so glad you're here! Today it's internet install day at a customer's home.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉朋友們，很高興你們又來了！今天是位在客戶家中的寬頻安裝日。
script.outro: And we're done for today! Listen again and hum along. Catch you next time!
script.outro_zh: 今天就要結尾囉！再聽一遍，跟著哼。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the whole dialogue — line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們把整段對話——一句一句重複。
script.char_a_description: a bouncy young woman in her late twenties with curly ginger hair pulled into a high ponytail, an oversized grey university hoodie, house slippers with cartoon bears on them, holding a laptop to her chest like a shield
script.char_b_description: a broad-shouldered Black man in his fifties with a shaved head and a silver-flecked goatee, wearing a navy cable-company uniform shirt with a radio clipped to the collar, heavy work boots and a warm smile
script.youtube_title: 【🛠️📶裝網路實錄】「這個要加錢嗎？」超實用寬頻安裝情境英文｜🖥️Internet Install English
script.youtube_title_en: “Does That Cost Extra?” — Scheduling an Internet Install and Fixing Weak Wi-Fi
script.youtube_description:
裝寬頻那天，技師問話都聽得懂卻不敢開口？這段超真實的安裝日對話幫你備好全套句子！從 router 擺哪裡、樓上訊號太弱，到加購訊號延伸器的月費，全部 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Nervous talking to the internet installer at your door? This super-realistic install-day conversation gets you ready: where the router goes, why upstairs signal dies, and what an extender costs — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📶裝網路英文｜約時段・機器擺位・訊號延伸器｜聽完就會問到底｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
約好裝網路當天，技師一開口你就緊張了？
訊號死角、加購費用，用英文要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一位客戶的客廳，跟著技師從確認兩小時到府時段、挑選 router 位置，到實測樓上訊號、加裝延伸器與月費，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🕐 時段與位置：例如「Right on time for the two-hour window.」、「Where's the outlet for the modem?」。
📶 訊號問題：例如「My upstairs rooms get almost no signal.」、「the bar is pretty low here.」。
💵 加購與費用：例如「Does that cost extra?」、「It's ten a month, or ninety to own it.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完這一集，下次裝機你比技師還清楚！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a wifi router while the tech points upstairs

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! You must be the internet technician.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ju məst bi ði ˈɪntərˌnɛt tɛkˈnɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！你一定是來裝網路的技師吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's me! Right on time for the two-hour window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi raɪt ɑn taɪm fɚ ðə tuˈaʊər ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是我！準時趕到兩小時的到府時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. My upstairs rooms get almost no signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt maɪ ˌʌpˈstɛrz ru mz ɡɛt ˈɔlˌmoʊst noʊ ˈsɪɡnəl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我樓上的房間幾乎都沒有訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll sort that. Where's the outlet for the modem?
dialogue.phonetic: /wil sɔrt ðæt wɛrz ði ˈaʊtlɛt fɚ ðə ˈmoʊˌdɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我們會處理好。數據機的插座在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Downstairs by the TV. Is that spot okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz baɪ ðə ˌtiˈvi ɪz ðæt spɑt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 在樓下電視旁邊。那個位置可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, that works. The router goes right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jæ ðæt wɜrks ðə ˈraʊtər ɡoʊz raɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，那個行。路由器就放在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But will the wifi really reach my office?
dialogue.phonetic: /bət wɪl ðə ˈwaɪˌfaɪ ˈriəli ritʃ maɪ ˈɔfəs/
dialogue.zh: 但是 wifi 真的收得到我書房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Might be weak up there. Let me test it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪt bi wik ʌp ðɛr lɪt mi tɛst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 樓上可能會弱。我來測一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… hmm, yeah, the bar is pretty low here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hʌm jæ ðə bɑrz ˈprɪti loʊ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 好的……嗯，果然這裡訊號只剩一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep an extender in the truck. One sec.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip æn ɪkˈstɛndər ɪn ðə trʌk wʌn sɛk/
dialogue.zh: 我車上放了一台延伸器。一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that fix the whole second floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðæt fɪks ðə hoʊl ˈsɛkˌnd flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那個可以修好整個二樓的訊號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes. Want me to grab it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəˌwɛli jɛs wɑnt mi tə ɡræb ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Does that cost extra?
dialogue.zh: 要的！那個要另外加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's ten a month, or ninety to own it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tɛn ə mʌnθ ɔr ˈnɪnti tə oʊn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一個月十塊，或一次九十塊直接買斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The monthly is fine for now, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmʌnθli ɪz faɪn fɚ naʊ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我現在先選月租的就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Give me ten minutes to set it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɡɪv mi tɛn ˈmɪnɪts tə sɛt ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 好。給我十分鐘把它裝起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome, thank you! Can I grab you a coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈsɔmə θæŋk ju kæn aɪ ɡræb ju ə ˈkɔˌfi/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，謝謝！我幫你先倒杯咖啡好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, that'd be great after this drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðæd bi ɡreɪt ˈæftər ðɪs draɪv/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，開了一路車正需要呢。
